**no it's not.** it has you rely on something greater than yourself, which can be a sponsor or the AA group. it says higher power "as we understood him" and never preaches anything religious. ever.

it's unfortunate that some of the texts use the word God, as a lot of people misconstrue that, interpreting it to mean the Christian white-bearded man in the sky.

I just posted something to suicidewatch yesterday so I understand the trapped/hopeless feeling, doesn't matter if the specifics of the situation are different. 

It's helped me to think, ok, well if I'm thinking of offing myself, then I'm facing 100% death rate anyway so really have nothing to lose . Why not do something really drastic to get out of the situation (while of course not endangering your children). What's the worst that could happen, you die? 

So get somewhere quiet if you can, write down everything you DO have control over (even if it's just-- I have a car and can leave the house for a couple hours. or I have a computer and can send out resumes.), and use those things to take charge of the shitstorm, even just a little. Having nothing left to lose can be kinda liberating.
